styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a mottled dark-grass ground tile with no outline, so there is no sticker look. It shows 4 visible tones per tile against 3 for the reference grass, and 0% near-flat coverage, the same as the reference. Its dark pixels are tinted, with 0% near-neutral. The speckled variation reads as grass grain and is comparable to the reference grass tile. It is a little less varied than the reference's clumped tufts and has only 4 raw colours against 26. But the visible-tone measure, which is the one that counts, matches or beats the reference. I see no flat fills, and a careful artist would accept it next to the reference grass.
